changedRows.sourceText: Pharaoh Necoh put him in bonds at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
changedRows.reasonJa: 23:31–32で捕らえられたヨアハズを、続けて「him」として述べる。
changedRows.priorReasonJa: この節では、本文に明記された人物・地名をdirect、直前から一意に続く代名詞・発話主体のみcontextで記録した。地名語が王国/領域を表す場合は族長個人IDへ結び付けない。

changedRows.sourceText: The LORD sent against him bands of the Chaldeans, bands of the Syrians, bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke by his servants the prophets.
changedRows.reasonJa: 24:1で反逆したヨヤキムに対して主が軍勢を送ったという連続文脈。
changedRows.priorReasonJa: 本文と前後文脈を照合し、固有名・集団・領域・明確な指示対象を個別に記録した。Judahは王国・領域と民のcollective用法を区別し、Syriansは地名へ流用しない。

changedRows.reasonJa: 25:22で名指されたバビロン王がゲダルヤを総督にした続き。

changedRows.sourceText: Gedaliah swore to them and to their men, and said to them, “Don’t be afraid because of the servants of the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.”

changedRows.sourceText: The king defiled the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mountain of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon.
changedRows.reasonJa: 「Chemosh the abomination of Moab」はモアブとの宗教・帰属関係を示す表現で、物理的な場所の指示ではない。
